integrity: The group-scheme equation is derived functorially over arbitrary commutative base algebras, and the symbolic checker verifies the universal identities. Finite-field enumeration is used only as a consistency check, not as a proof of the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the characteristic-two family \(L_8(\lambda)\); no classification of automorphism-scheme smoothness for the other three-dimensional Leibniz types is claimed.
title: A non-smooth automorphism scheme for the characteristic-two Leibniz family \(L_8(\lambda)\)
